acronyms.description: Jangar's index of the reconciled Git repository snapshot. Atlas search requires a ready corpus for the exact requested commit.
acronyms.name: Atlas

acronyms.description: A search unit derived from a file version. The audit view reports counts and timestamps, not chunk text or embedding vectors.
acronyms.name: Atlas chunk

acronyms.description: The identity of a file within a repository. The current Atlas corpus stores at most one file version for each file key.
acronyms.name: Atlas file key

acronyms.description: A recorded indexing workflow attempt associated with a GitHub event. An event can have more than one attempt.
acronyms.name: Atlas ingestion

customAnalyses.description: Last successful Atlas index time and current recorded status per repository. Missing timestamps sort first. Age measures the last successful index, not whether Atlas matches the current Git head.
customAnalyses.name: Atlas indexing freshness
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT repository_id, index_status, indexed_at, updated_at,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - indexed_at) / 3600, 2) AS hours_since_success
FROM jangar_audit.atlas_repositories
ORDER BY indexed_at ASC NULLS FIRST, repository_id
LIMIT 100

customAnalyses.description: File counts, share of indexed files, and recorded line counts by repository and language in the current corpus. This is observed coverage, not a comparison against Git.
customAnalyses.name: Atlas file and language coverage
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT repository_id, language, COUNT(*) AS indexed_files, SUM(line_count) AS indexed_lines,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY repository_id), 2) AS pct_of_indexed_files
FROM jangar_audit.atlas_file_versions
GROUP BY repository_id, language
ORDER BY indexed_files DESC, repository_id, language
LIMIT 100

customAnalyses.description: Current chunk and embedding counts per repository, newest timestamps, and age of the oldest chunk without an embedding. Presence does not prove that the embedding uses the current model.
customAnalyses.name: Atlas chunk embedding lag
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT repository_id, SUM(chunk_count) AS chunks, SUM(embedded_chunk_count) AS embedded_chunks,
  SUM(chunk_count) - SUM(embedded_chunk_count) AS unembedded_chunks,
  MAX(newest_chunk_at) AS newest_chunk_at, MAX(newest_embedding_at) AS newest_embedding_at,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - MIN(oldest_unembedded_at)) / 60, 2) AS oldest_unembedded_minutes
FROM jangar_audit.atlas_chunk_coverage
GROUP BY repository_id
ORDER BY unembedded_chunks DESC, repository_id
LIMIT 100

customAnalyses.description: Daily UTC counts by event type for GitHub deliveries received in the last 14 days, including those without a recorded processing time. Processing does not imply a successful index.
customAnalyses.name: Atlas GitHub event intake
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', received_at, 'UTC') AS intake_day_utc, event_type,
  COUNT(*) AS received_events, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processed_at IS NULL) AS unprocessed_events
FROM jangar_audit.atlas_github_events
WHERE received_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '14 days'
  AND received_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
GROUP BY 1, event_type
ORDER BY intake_day_utc DESC, received_events DESC, event_type
LIMIT 300

rules.description: Run Jangar ontology queries through jangar_audit on the standby. Keep raw Atlas and application relations outside the catalog.
rules.name: Atlas audit projections only

rules.description: Use the exact requested Git commit and the production Atlas verification contract in docs/atlas/README.md to prove corpus completeness. Counts, embedding presence, and freshness are diagnostics.
rules.name: Atlas coverage is not completeness

rules.description: Distinguish event receipt, event processing, and indexing success. A processed GitHub delivery may have been skipped or may have started an ingestion that failed.
rules.name: Atlas intake is not index completion
